name: BrightLocal
description:
BrightLocal is a local SEO platform used bySMBs, agencies and multi-location brands to track rankings, monitor reviews and manage business listings. This connector links Claude to your BrightLocal account with secure, authenticated access, so you can explore your local SEO data with natural language queries.

Ask about any location and get live answers:

• Rankings: pull the latest Local Rank Tracker results, see which keywords gained or lost positions across Google and Bing, and review run history over time.
• Local Search Grid: see how you rank at every point of a geographic grid, find the neighbourhoods where visibility drops off, and compare competitors point by point.
• Reviews: fetch reviews from a number of platforms via Reputation Manager, filter by rating, date or platform, and summarise the themes worth acting on.
• Citations: audit where your business is listed with Citation Tracker, and use Citation Builder lookups to find gaps and inconsistent listings.
• Listings: check a location's name, address, phone, hours and photos, and catch Active Sync alerts when your live data on Google, Facebook, Apple or Bing drifts from your records.
• Recommendations: get a prioritised, AI-powered action plan for each location.

Connections can be read-only or read-write; you choose when you authorise the connector. Read-write access additionally lets Claude create locations and clients, set up and run reports, upload photos and logos, and order citation campaigns. Actions that spend credits or change live listings always ask for your confirmation first.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BrightLocal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BrightLocal to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.brightlocal.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BrightLocal MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BrightLocal lists 65 MCP tools, including active_sync_change_alerts_tool, business_categories_by_country, cancel_active_sync_request, confirm_cb_campaign, create_cb_campaign, create_cb_secondary_campaign, create_client, create_ct_report, create_location, create_location_from_maps_url, create_location_from_place_id, and create_lrt_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BrightLocal?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BrightLocal in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
BrightLocal requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BrightLocal is developed by BrightLocal. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
